title: Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi Joined as the Secretary-cum-Scientific Director of IPC on 16.02.2021
bodyHtml:
Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi has joined as the Secretary-cum-Scientific Director of the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) on 16th February 2021.

Dr. Raghuvanshi was formally welcomed by the IPC staff on 17th February 2021.
